params.command: $listeners=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 7331,7443 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess); $pids=@($listeners|ForEach-Object{$_.OwningProcess}|Sort-Object -Unique); $procs=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $pids -contains $_.ProcessId } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine); [ordered]@{listeners=$listeners;processes=$procs}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
